item.tib: dbal phur khro bcu gsang sgrab las skyabs sems maN+Dal gsol 'debs yan lag
item.coloph: de ltar dbal phur nag po khro bcu gsang sgrub kyi/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum kun la dgos pa'i man ngag sngon du 'gro ba'i las kyi rim pa ni/ mkha' 'gying gzi brjid dbang gi rgyud las btus shing / gud du bkol nas dkar la btab pa 'di/ phyi rabs sgrub gshen rnams kyi don chad du/ sprul sku las ldan gshen gyi rjes 'jug pa/ she tsu khi khar bdag gis sbyar ba'i don/ 'gro rnams sngags kyi don la rab bsnyen nas/ mchog thun dngos grub ma lus rdzogs par shog dar rgyas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam gyur cig/
